title: Apply the guarded ordinary manual serving-revision switch

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Serving-revision switch tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/serving_control/test_serving_revision_switch.py

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-001 RED: serving_control has no ordinary manual A-to-B command that consumes the completed processing guard inside the shared serving context before committing B; GREEN: the owner command validates B, consumes the guard result, returns the audited requested/committed revision result, preserves A and produces no Photo, processing, deployment or model-process side effect on rejection, and commits B only on a clear result; decisive comparison: blocked and clear guard integrations compare the committed revision and no-deployment snapshot, while an interleaved admission/switch yields only committed A plus rejected B or committed B plus a B admission; artifact: disposable serving-control integration matrix and transaction trace.
purpose: Implement the serving_control-owned manual command that applies the completed processing guard and serializes a possible A-to-B serving decision with admission.
success_outcome: A manual A-to-B request returns its audited owner result, rejects without deployment side effect when the completed guard blocks, and commits validated B only through the serial serving context that admission also uses.
anti_goals: Do not reimplement the processing guard or read/write processing rows directly from serving_control.
Do not add a revision registry, switch/job lifecycle, persisted mode, automatic drain, rollback, deployment action or generic coordination framework.
Do not add a transport route, staff role, authentication mechanism, realtime query behavior, Calibration integration or FT-011 model-comparison execution.

forbidden_scope: The processing-owned exact-A guard and its state-matrix proof owned by TASK-039-T2-FT-002-W6
Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation, comparison execution and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
Model asset deployment, worker/realtime restart, automatic rollback or direct database edits as an ordinary revision-switch path
stop_conditions: Admission and the serving decision cannot serialize through the accepted serving context without a new ownership edge or durable coordination mechanism.
A correct command requires serving_control to inspect processing rows directly, processing to mutate serving selection, or a new switch lifecycle/state.
A correct command would require a new public transport/auth contract, model comparison integration or deployment behavior.

constraints: serving_control resolves exact current A and validates requested B inside the owner-held serving context, asks the completed processing guard only for its read-only result, and returns the contract result naming requested and committed revisions.

Admission obtains the same serving-context serialization before it commits its immutable revision snapshot and matching pending state, so it either completes under A before the guard or starts under B after B commits.

Use validated disposable A/B revisions, one SPA and task-owned Photos with known state, safe rerun and complete cleanup; retain the existing caller authorization boundary without adding a transport or role.
invariants: A guard rejection preserves A, every Photo and processing state, and the current deployment/model-process binding.
Only a clear completed guard result permits the validated B commit; serving_control never accesses processing rows directly and processing never writes serving selection.
The command introduces no persisted switch state, background drain, automatic rollback or deployment side effect, and model comparison remains test-only with no bypass.
verification_targets: Disposable blocked and clear guard integrations prove the audited requested/current result, unchanged A/no deployment effect on rejection, and validated B commit only on a clear result without adopting the dependency's exact-A state-matrix claim.

An interleaved admission/switch transaction probe proves one serial outcome only: completed A admission blocks B, or B commits before the new Photo receives its immutable B snapshot and matching B pending row.

Static and transaction tracing proves serving_control reaches processing only through the read-only guard, makes no direct processing-row access or foreign write bypass, and model-comparison fixtures cannot invoke or bypass the command.
